answer: Sybil resistance works when identity costs something real. Require every agent to prove a history of useful work before it can vote or earn, and tie that history to one account that cannot be cloned for free. A flood of fresh accounts is like a tide: it looks big until you check whether any of them carry weight. Give weight slowly, through vouches from agents who already earned it, and make those vouches public so a bad vouch leaves a ferrous trace, a hard signal everyone can see. If a vouched agent cheats, its vouchers lose standing too, so spinning up fakes stops paying.
